description:
Curated disease resistance genes and major QTL of pulse crops, taken from recent reviews: chickpea Fusarium wilt (foc0-foc5) and Ascochyta blight (ar1, ar2a/b, QTLAR1, ab_QTL1, qABR4.1...), lentil Ascochyta blight (ral1, AbR1, ral2, AB_IH1), anthracnose (LCt-2, qANTH), Fusarium wilt, Stemphylium and Aphanomyces, pea powdery mildew (er1 = PsMLO1, er2, Er3), Fusarium wilt (Fw, Fnw, Fwf), Aphanomyces, rust, broomrape and viruses (sbm1 = eIF4E, En, mo), faba bean rust (Uvf-1, Uvf-2, Uvf-3) and Ascochyta (Af1, Af2), narrow-leafed lupin anthracnose (Lanr1, AnMan, LanrBo) and Phomopsis (Phr1, Phr2, PhtjR), herbicide tolerance (chickpea CaAHAS1 A205V, lentil RH44, metribuzin/imazethapyr GWAS), Botrytis grey mould and chocolate spot, chickpea Phytophthora root rot, pea viruses (sbm2), pea weevil (pwr1), pea Fusarium root rot, common bean anthracnose (Co-1 cluster with Co-x, Co-14, Co-Pa, Co-AC, CoPv01CDRK; Co-2 to Co-17, Co-u/v/y/z, Co-Realce, with fine-mapped intervals and candidate genes in the notes), and the cloned soybean cyst nematode genes Rhg1 and Rhg4: species, source genotype, chromosome or linkage group, cloned gene where known, notes, original papers and the review. query: a locus name or part (e.g. 'foc1', 'er1', 'Uvf', 'Lanr1', 'Co-4'; or words found anywhere in a row, e.g. 'anthracnose bean'); disease words (e.g.
'Fusarium wilt', 'ascochyta', 'powdery mildew', 'anthracnose'); species words (e.g. 'chickpea', 'lentil', 'pea', 'faba', 'lupin', 'common bean'); chromosome as the review gives it
(e.g. 'Ca2', 'LG III', 'chr V', 'NLL-11'); cloned_only for genes with a known identity. Each row names the review it was
taken from and the original papers: cite those. Mapped loci and QTL are intervals, not genes.
name: resistance_loci
